arxiv-2212-12593.title: Convexification Numerical Method for a Coefficient Inverse Problem for the Riemannian Radiative Transfer Equation Thanks: 2023.04.12
arxiv-2212-12593.creator: Michael V. Klibanov, Jingzhi Li, Loc H. Nguyen, Vladimir G. Romanov, Zhipeng Yang
arxiv-2212-12593.description: Abstract The first globally convergent numerical method for a Coefficient Inverse Problem (CIP) for the Riemannian Radiative Transfer Equation (RRTE) is constructed. This is a version of the so-called “convexification” method, which has been pursued by this research group for a number of years for some other CIPs for PDEs. Those PDEs are significantly different from the RRTE.

arxiv-2306-10355.creator: The CMS Collaboration
arxiv-2306-10355.description: Abstract A description is presented of the algorithms used to reconstruct energy deposited in the CMS hadron calorimeter during Run 2 (2015–2018) of the LHC. During Run 2, the characteristic bunch-crossing spacing for proton-proton collisions was 25 \unit ​ n ​ s \unit{ns} , which resulted in overlapping signals from adjacent crossings.

arxiv-2405-20921.title: Atomistic spin dynamics simulations of magnonic spin Seebeck and spin Nernst effects in altermagnets
arxiv-2405-20921.creator: Markus Weißenhofer, Alberto Marmodoro
arxiv-2405-20921.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Markus Weißenhofer, Alberto Marmodoro. Magnon band structures in altermagnets are characterized by an energy splitting of modes with opposite chirality, even in the absence of applied external fields and relativistic effects, due to an anisotropy in the Heisenberg exchange interactions. We perform quantitative atomistic spin dynamics simulations based on ab initio electronic structure calculations on rutile RuO 2 , a prototypical ”d-wave” altermagnet, to study magnon currents generated by thermal gradients.

arxiv-2506-14506.title: An independent search for Jovian neutrinos using BOREXINO data
arxiv-2506-14506.creator: Yuva Himanshu Pallam 1, Shantanu Desai 2
arxiv-2506-14506.description: Abstract In a recent study, Ansarifard and Farzan 2024 found evidence for a 6% flux contribution from Jupiter to the total flux rate time series data from the BOREXINO solar neutrino experiment, specifically during the time intervals 2019-2021 and 2011-2013. The significance of this detection was estimated to be around 2 ​ σ 2\sigma .

arxiv-2511-04774.title: SLOFetch: Compressed Hierarchical Instruction Prefetching for Cloud Microservices
arxiv-2511-04774.creator: Zerui Bao 6 1 , Di Zhu 2 1 *, Liu Jiang 6 2 , Shiqi Sheng 6 3 , Ziwei Wang 3 4 , Haoyun Zhang 4 4
arxiv-2511-04774.description: Abstract Large scale networked services rely on deep software stacks and microservice orchestration, which enlarge instruction footprints and aggravate frontend stalls that inflate tail latency and energy. We revisit instruction prefetching for these cloud workloads and present a design aligned with SLO driven and self optimizing systems.

The effects of fructose to induce fatty

pmc-11525132.title: Ayurvedic management of hemangiomatous ulcer: A case report
pmc-11525132.creator: Praveen Kumar Yadav, SD Laxmikant
pmc-11525132.description: The most frequent infantile tumor is a hemangioma, and its most common complication is ulceration. A quickly progressing ulcer called a hemangioma can also result in secondary infection. The mechanism of ulcer formation is unknown but is thought to develop during the rapid growth phase.

pmc-11577319.title: Realizing Ultrahigh Near-Room-Temperature Thermoelectric Figure of Merit for N-Type Mg3(Sb,Bi)2 through Grain Boundary Complexion Engineering with Niobium
pmc-11577319.creator: Melis Ozen, Arda Baran Burcak, Duncan Zavanelli, Minsu Heo, Mujde Yahyaoglu, Yahya Oz, Ulrich Burkhardt, Hyun-Sik Kim, G. Jeffrey Snyder, Umut Aydemir
pmc-11577319.description: Despite decades of extensive research on thermoelectric materials, Bi2Te3 alloys have dominated room-temperature applications. However, recent advancements have highlighted the potential of alternative candidates, notably Mg3Sb2–Mg3Bi2 alloys, for low- to mid-temperature ranges. This study optimizes the low-temperature composition of this alloy system through Nb addition (Mg3.2–xNbx(Sb0.3Bi0.7)1.996Te0.004), characterizing composition, microstructure, and transport properties.

pmc-11674584.title: Outbreak of Acute Fulminant Myocarditis in Children in Campania Region, Italy: A Case Series
pmc-11674584.creator: Antonietta Giannattasio, Marco Maglione, Giangiacomo Di Nardo, Giovanni Maria Di Marco, Daria Lauretta, Maria Chiara Carrella, Daniela Furlan, Fabio Savoia, Vincenzo Tipo, Bibhuti B Das
pmc-11674584.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Acute fulminant myocarditis is a rare event in children, accounting for about 10% of all cases of acute myocarditis. Its lack of specific onset patterns and unpredictable evolution make diagnosis and prompt treatment challenging. We observed six cases of fulminant myocarditis admitted to our Pediatric Emergency Unit (Campania region, Sothern Italy) within a very short timeframe (50 days, from July to September 2024).

pmc-11712671.title: A new class of neurodegenerative disease‐fighting drugs: morADC (Morphomer®‐ antibody drug conjugates)
pmc-11712671.creator: Sreenivasachary Nampally, Oskar Adolfsson, Camille Martin, Romain Ollier, Sebastien Menant, Elpida Tsika, Alexis Fenyi, Nadine Ait‐Bouziad, Lorene Aeschbach, Sylvain Pautet, Aline Fuchs, David Ribas, Madiha Derouazi, Andrea Pfeifer, Marie Kosco‐Vilbois
pmc-11712671.description: BackgroundAntibody‐drug conjugates (ADCs) represent a major advancement in oncology to deliver selectively cytotoxic drug to tumor cells while reducing their exposure to normal tissues. Each ADC consists of a monoclonal antibody (mAb) selective to a tumor specific/overexpressed surface antigen conjugated to the cytotoxic agent.

pmc-12469028.title: Quantitative Analysis of Intracranial Atherosclerosis and Its Correlation with Ischemic Cerebrovascular Disease and Prognosis
pmc-12469028.creator: Jingjing Cai, Sizhan Chen, Shiyu Hu, Lijie Ren, Gelin Xu, Evanthia Bernitsas, Carlo A Mallio, Gianfranco Di Gennaro, Andrea Elefante
pmc-12469028.description: Background: Intracranial atherosclerosis disease (ICAD) represents a significant etiology of stroke. This study aimed to evaluate correlations between intracranial atherosclerotic burden and risk of ischemic events. Methods: In this prospective observational study, all enrolled patients underwent High-Resolution Magnetic Resonance vessel wall Imaging (HR MR-VMI) within two weeks of onset, or of enrollment.

pmc-12689367.title: Exploratory spatial transcriptomic profiling of peritumoral Th2 immune polarization in HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer
pmc-12689367.creator: Naohiro Wakisaka, Makiko Moriyama-Kita, Satoru Kondo, Eiji Kobayashi, Takayoshi Ueno, Yosuke Nakanishi, Kazuhira Endo, Hisashi Sugimoto, Tomokazu Yoshizaki
pmc-12689367.description: IntroductionOropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPC) associated with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV-16, generally shows favorable outcomes yet paradoxically exhibits a high incidence of early lymphatic metastasis. The immune mechanisms underlying this phenomenon remain unclear.MethodsWe conducted an exploratory spatial transcriptomic analysis using the GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiler on formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded samples from six patients with palatine tonsil-derived OPC.

pmc-12729003.title: Arterial collagen IV and laminin levels associate with type 2 diabetes, glycemic control, major adverse cardiac events, and mortality in coronary bypass patients
pmc-12729003.creator: Anne-Sofie Allermann Faarvang, Martin Overgaard, Pia Søndergaard Jensen, Lars Peter Schødt Riber, Mette Wod, Lasse Bach Steffensen, Lars Melholt Rasmussen
pmc-12729003.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is associated with arterial diseases; particularly, the incidence of atherosclerotic conditions is increased among patients with diabetes. Basement membrane (BM) protein levels are increased in the artery wall of T2DM patients, but the underlying mechanisms and potential consequences remain elusive.

pmc-12820229.title: Cross-species validation of a human age-related hearing loss candidate KLHDC7B as essential for mammalian hearing
pmc-12820229.creator: Alexandra M Kaufman, Benjamin Silver, Roberto A Donnianni, Carlos Aguilar, Lingzi Niu, Daniel Johnson, Anwen Bullen, Alma Corona, Benjamin J van Soldt, Nilay Vora, Gervasio Batista, Luz Cortes-Burgos, Jacqueline Copeland, Elika Fallah, Norman Zhang, Marina Lehmkuhl, Sarah Cancelarich, Kara Campos, D
pmc-12820229.description: Although age-related hearing loss (ARHL) is the most common sensory loss in older adults, underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Recent genome-wide association studies (GWAS) linked variation in several genes with ARHL risk, including KLHDC7B, a gene of unknown function not previously linked to hearing. We demonstrate Klhdc7b is expressed exclusively in sensory hair cells in mouse cochlea.

pmc-13238087.title: Pro-environmental behavioral intention in university energy-saving contexts: extending the Value–Belief–Norm framework with institutional support
pmc-13238087.creator: Xiaolin Zhang, Songyu Jiang, Jirawan Deeprasert
pmc-13238087.description: ObjectiveWith increasing energy demands across the globe and increased focus in sustainable development agenda, higher education institutions (HEIs) are relevant in developing energy-saving cognitions and attitudes of students.PurposeThis paper will examine how university leadership, sustainability-oriented education, environmental values, environmental beliefs, and personal norms influence and affect the pro-environmental behavioral intention (PEBI) of HEIs students.

pmc-13498928.title: Coronal and Root Caries in Older Adults: Associated Factors, Quality of Life Impact, and Treatment—A Scoping Review
pmc-13498928.creator: Helena Dujic, Katrin Heck, Julia Schwärzler, Cristiane da Mata, Sayaka Tada, Falk Schwendicke
pmc-13498928.description: BackgroundDental caries remains one of the most common chronic diseases affecting older adults worldwide. As edentulism decreases and more natural teeth are retained into old age, the number of susceptible tooth surfaces increases. Age‐related factors such as polypharmacy, cognitive decline, and reduced oral hygiene skills, together with systemic and social factors, increase the risk of caries.
